verdict.rationale: Qdrant is a vector database with a managed cloud offering, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence shows no such assistant. The agent skills and official MCP server equip external AI coding assistants to work with Qdrant. That is adjacent capability, not an assistant inside the product that users can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
